name: talent-show
description: Claude Code plugins from kubed-io: skills, one plugin per tool, and the hooks and agents our own sessions run.

plugins.name: drawio
plugins.description: Draw and edit draw.io diagrams: small, cheap edits to the diagram open in a live editor through lgazo/drawio-mcp-server, or .drawio files when none is open. Icon styles that render, a map of draw.io's docs, and prompts to draw, edit, tidy and explain.

plugins.name: ultrapowers
plugins.description: The turns of an issue-to-pull-request agent flow, as prompts on top of superpowers: draft the spec, plan once it is approved, build the plan a task at a time, answer failed checks and reviews, review the change with a security pass by a subagent, assess a bug without fixing it, and carry an issue through its sub-issues.

plugins.name: kubed-claude
plugins.description: Field notes on Claude Code, checked by running it: what a subagent really gets, agent files and their MCP servers, prompts as plugin commands and MCP prompts, MCP config and skills served over MCP, and headless runs. Grows as we learn.

plugins.name: tidy
plugins.description: Cleanup skills for code an agent wrote. natural-writing: comments, docstrings, commit messages, pull requests, READMEs and specs that read like a careful engineer wrote them, and a pass that trims the rest. python-refactor: restructuring Python without changing what it does.

plugins.name: kubed-control
plugins.description: Hooks for every session: its title, and the plan's real 5-hour and weekly usage, as OpenTelemetry metrics to $KUBED_OTLP_METRICS_ENDPOINT.

plugins.name: kubed-runner
plugins.description: A CI runner's entry agents (spec, plan, code, review, debug, info) and the MCP servers they may use, signed in by client credentials. Off until a run turns it on.

plugins.name: kb-agents
plugins.description: A mod that loads the subagents kb serves when a session starts, narrowed by library, category and tag.
